description: This Java class defines the default implementation of a supervisor configuration for connection management, including methods for instantiation from a Config object, and overrides for equality, hash, and string representation.

classes.name: DefaultSupervisorConfig
classes.description: Immutable class implementing SupervisorConfig, managing supervisor settings including exponential back-off configuration.

methods.name: DefaultSupervisorConfig.of
methods.description: Creates an instance of DefaultSupervisorConfig from a Config object at the specified CONFIG_PATH, handling potential configuration errors.

methods.name: getExponentialBackOffConfig
methods.description: Returns the ExponentialBackOffConfig associated with this supervisor configuration.
